US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average state income tax for an $85k USD earner.

IN.description: Progressive income tax, including a 4% health and education cess.

SG.description: Effective income tax rate for an S$115,000 (approx. $85k USD) earner, based on Singapore's progressive tax system. This excludes mandatory Central Provident Fund (CPF) contributions and there is no capital gains tax.

CH.description: Effective rate for federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions in Zurich.

NL.description: Effective rate includes national income tax (Box 1) and social security contributions.

GB.description: Includes Income Tax and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal income tax, provincial income tax (Ontario assumed), Canada Pension Plan (CPP), and Employment Insurance (EI) contributions.

AE.description: No personal income tax for individuals, only indirect taxes like VAT

NO.description: Includes national income tax (trinnskatt), municipal tax, and social security contributions, calculated for an approximate 910,000 NOK annual income.

IE.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for an employed individual, considering tax credits and progressive bands.

LU.description: Includes national income tax and mandatory social security contributions (pension, health, long-term care) for a single earner.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy

QA.description: Qatar does not impose personal income tax on salaries and wages for residents.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam has no personal income tax for its citizens or residents, resulting in an effective tax rate of 0% for an $85k USD earner.

MO.description: Effective personal income tax rate includes progressive taxation with a substantial tax-free threshold and a 30% tax reduction, capped at MOP 14,000 annually.
